$comment: THE single source of truth for the H2 Overview aggregate money shapes (the nested objects where a field rename silently blanks a column — the principalAtomic-vs-principalUsdc bug this file exists to prevent). The daemon's ownerapi contract_test.go asserts its marshaled output uses EXACTLY the `emits` keys for each object. The dashboard's aggregate-contract.test.ts asserts, per object, that `emits` ∪ `daemonOmits` equals the full key set of the matching lib/types.ts DTO (bound with keyof, so a DTO field added or renamed fails to compile until reflected here). A rename on either side fails one of those tests red. Edit this file only when both sides agree.

daemonOmits.$comment: Fields the dashboard DTO declares but the daemon does not source, so it omits them and the UI renders a dash (pool TVL/fees/utilisation/reserve come from /api/float; customer/title/state are daemon-side only; rateBps has no per-advance value). Listed explicitly so a NEW required field the daemon forgets to emit is caught here rather than silently blanked.
